name: American Made Apparel Manufacturing., Inc.
old_description: If you’re looking for full-service, cut and sew company professionals, talk to American Made Apparel Manufacturing in Denver. We have over 30 years of experience helping our clients develop high-quality, custom apparel (and so much more) from our fully-equipped facility. Using the latest equipment and methods, we can mass-produce just about anything you can imagine.
about:
American Made Apparel Manufacturing, Inc. was founded in 1996 in Aurora, Colorado. The company operates a fully equipped facility in the Denver metropolitan area, specializing in domestic apparel production.

The shop provides end-to-end cut-and-sew services, from design consultation and pattern drafting using CAD/CAM software to size grading via Accumark Gerber technology, prototype development, fabric laying and cutting on over 24 yards of table space, machine-assisted cutting, sewing, and final inspection. Every order is tagged, packed by size, and shipped or held for pickup.

Clients include sports-apparel brands and businesses seeking custom garment manufacturing; the company cites a collaboration with Fire Within as an example of its custom product process. It serves brands, designers, and companies needing domestic production runs of varying sizes.

American Made emphasizes its "100% Made in America" designation, stringent quality standards, and open communication throughout each project. The company states that it differentiates itself by guiding clients through every step—from initial sketches to finished goods—and by treating each client as its only client.
